scientific_boundary: The old 90-day source gate remains failed and is not rewritten.
The missing bid/ask sizes remain an execution/capacity blocker.
This experiment asks only whether the 68-day SOURCE_LIMITED parquet contains quote-price carry worth further replication.
A positive result cannot promote to diamond/quasi-diamond, production, shadow execution, or capital.
mechanism: BTC option implied-volatility/carry premium may exceed subsequent 24h repricing often enough for a prospectively selected near-30D ATM short straddle to show positive quote-based carry after standard option trading fees.

selection.entry_day_rule: Each UTC calendar day with an 08:00-hour snapshot; no nearest-hour substitution.
selection.strike_choice: Within chosen expiry, among strikes with both call and put at entry, minimize abs(log(strike/median_underlying_price_at_entry)); tie -> lower strike.
selection.no_fallback_rule: After the pair is selected, if either selected instrument lacks valid next-calendar-day 08:00 exit quote, skip the episode. Do not choose a second-best expiry or strike.
selection.entry_execution: Sell one call and one put at their best bid prices.
selection.exit_execution: Buy back the same instruments next calendar day at their best ask prices.

fee_model.note: Standard trading-fee model only; spread is already represented by bid-entry/ask-exit.

forbidden_rescues: Do not change 08:00 UTC after outcomes.
Do not change 24h hold after outcomes.
Do not change 25-35 DTE or target 30 after outcomes.
Do not choose another strike rule after outcomes.
Do not use mark or midpoint after outcomes.
Do not invert long/short direction after outcomes.
Do not remove fees after outcomes.
Do not infer executable capacity from missing quote sizes.
